nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) holding the token balance of every holder.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Private mapping(address=>bool) marking addresses exempt from the burn/tx-cap logic.
Immutable router address 0x1B6f...4F7A whitelisted at construction time.
Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public burn percentage (10) applied to non-whitelisted transfers.
Private total supply, initialized to 1_000_000_000 and reduced by every burn.
Private per-transaction cap of 1_000_000_000 applied to non-whitelisted transfers.
Initializes ERC20Detailed metadata, sets _owner, mints the supply and whitelists owner and router.
Internal view helper returning _whitelist[adr]; drives the burn branch selection.
External view returning _totalSupply.
External view returning _allowed[owner][spender].
External view returning _balances[owner].
Public pure helper computing ceil(value,100)*rate/100, i.e. the burn amount.
Internal setter writing _whitelist[adr] = state.
External ERC20 transfer; whitelisted senders move value directly, others pay a 10% burn and must respect _txCap.
External ERC20 transferFrom; checks allowance, applies burn logic and decrements _allowed for non-whitelisted senders.
External approval setting _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Public helper adding addedValue to the caller's allowance.
Public helper subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and constructor owner.
transfer debits _balances[msg.sender] and credits _balances[to]; arithmetic state mutation without reentrancy concerns but no zero-amount guard.
transfer burns tokensToBurn and decrements _totalSupply._totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn) is an unchecked-supply arithmetic mutation.
transferFrom decrements _allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(value) after balance mutations, an arithmetic allowance mutation.
transferFrom burns tokensToBurn and decrements _totalSupply via sub, an arithmetic supply mutation.
Recipient address argument of transfer(to, value).
Amount argument of transfer(to, value).
Source address argument of transferFrom(from, to, value).
Recipient address argument of transferFrom(from, to, value).
Amount argument of transferFrom(from, to, value).
Spender address argument of approve(spender, value).
Allowance amount argument of approve(spender, value).
Spender address argument of increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue).
Increment amount argument of increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue).
Spender address argument of decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue).
Decrement amount argument of decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue).
Rate argument of findBurnAmount(rate, value), receiving burnPct.
Value argument of findBurnAmount(rate, value) used in the ceil/mul/div computation.
Address argument of _modifyWhitelist(adr, state).
Boolean flag argument of _modifyWhitelist(adr, state).
Address argument of balanceOf(owner) used as key into _balances.
Owner address argument of allowance(owner, spender).
Spender address argument of allowance(owner, spender).
Local in transfer: burn amount = findBurnAmount(burnPct, value).
Local in transfer: value.sub(tokensToBurn), amount credited to the recipient.
Local in transferFrom: burn amount = findBurnAmount(burnPct, value).
Local in transferFrom: value.sub(tokensToBurn), amount credited to the recipient.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender, making the deployer-controlled caller the privileged owner.
transfer reads and writes _balances[msg.sender], so the caller selects the debited account.
transferFrom checks and decrements _allowed[from][msg.sender], caller identity controls the allowance used.
approve writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender], caller identity is the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance mutates _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance mutates _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer reads _balances[msg.sender]/[to] for the require check and writes the debited/credited balances.
transferFrom reads and writes _balances[from]/[to].
balanceOf returns _balances[owner].
transferFrom reads _allowed[from][msg.sender] and decrements it.
allowance returns _allowed[owner][spender].
approve overwrites _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
increaseAllowance adds to _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance subtracts from _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
_checkWhitelist returns _whitelist[adr].
_modifyWhitelist writes _whitelist[adr].
transfer passes burnPct into findBurnAmount to size the burn.
transferFrom passes burnPct into findBurnAmount to size the burn.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
transfer decrements _totalSupply by the burn amount.
transferFrom decrements _totalSupply by the burn amount.
transfer enforces value <= _txCap for non-whitelisted senders.
transferFrom enforces value <= _txCap for non-whitelisted sources.
Constructor whitelists the constant _router address.
Constructor sets _owner and credits it the entire supply.
_checkWhitelist(msg.sender) selects between the direct-transfer branch and the burn branch.
_checkWhitelist(from) selects between the direct-transfer branch and the burn branch.
Constructor calls _modifyWhitelist for _owner and _router.
findBurnAmount output feeds the burn and tokensToTransfer computation in transfer.
findBurnAmount output feeds the burn and tokensToTransfer computation in transferFrom.
transfer performs the balance debit/credit state mutation.
transfer executes the burn and _totalSupply decrement.
transferFrom performs the allowance decrement state mutation.
transferFrom executes the burn and _totalSupply decrement.
The debited balance account in transfer is msg.sender.
The burned tokens are taken from msg.sender's balance.
The allowance entry decremented is keyed by msg.sender.
The burned amount in transferFrom ultimately derives from the caller's allowance.
_balances is the storage slot mutated by the debit/credit operation.
_totalSupply is decremented by the transfer burn operation.
_allowed is the storage slot decremented by transferFrom.
_totalSupply is decremented by the transferFrom burn operation.
transfer credits the to address.
transfer validates and splits value into burn and transfer amounts.
transferFrom debits _balances[from] and reads _allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom credits the to address.
transferFrom validates and splits value into burn and transfer amounts.
approve uses spender as the allowance key.
approve stores value into _allowed.
increaseAllowance uses spender as the allowance key.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the stored allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses spender as the allowance key.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from the stored allowance.
findBurnAmount multiplies the ceil-rounded value by rate.
findBurnAmount rounds value up to the nearest hundred before multiplying.
_modifyWhitelist sets _whitelist[adr].
_modifyWhitelist stores the state boolean.
balanceOf looks up _balances[owner].
allowance looks up _allowed[owner][spender].
allowance uses spender as the inner mapping key.
tokensToBurn is computed from the value argument and burnPct.
tokensToBurn drives the burn emit and _totalSupply decrement in transfer.
tokensToTransfer is the credited amount in transfer.
tokensToBurn in transferFrom is computed from the value argument and burnPct.
tokensToBurn drives the burn emit and _totalSupply decrement in transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer is the credited amount in transferFrom.

The value argument of transfer is only consumed by the transfer function body.
The from argument is only consumed by transferFrom.
The to argument is only consumed by transferFrom.
The value argument is only consumed by transferFrom.
The spender argument is only consumed by approve.
The value argument is only consumed by approve.
The spender argument is only consumed by increaseAllowance.
The addedValue argument only feeds the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
The spender argument is only consumed by decreaseAllowance.
The subtractedValue argument only feeds the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
The rate argument is only used inside the pure burn computation.
The value argument is only used inside the pure burn computation.
The adr argument is only used as the _whitelist key.
The state argument is only used as the _whitelist value.
The owner argument is only used as the _balances lookup key.
The owner argument is only used as the outer _allowed key.
The spender argument is only used as the inner _allowed key.
tokensToBurn is the amount destroyed by the transfer burn operation.
tokensToTransfer is the credited amount written by transfer.
tokensToBurn is the amount destroyed by the transferFrom burn operation.
